# Smart Coir Manufacturing & Supply Chain Management System - Complete Overview

> Smart Coir is an enterprise-grade digital ecosystem for coir manufacturing management, raw material quality tracking, inventory logistics, and wholesale buyer order fulfillment.

## Platform Capabilities

### 1. Buyer & Client Services
- Product Catalog Browsing: Coir Blocks, Coir Pith, Coir Fiber, Coco Peat, Geotextiles.
- Bulk Order Processing with Automated GST Tax calculation and Shipping Logistics.
- Invoice Generation & PDF Downloading.
- Order Tracking with Status Timelines: Pending -> Confirmed -> Processing -> Shipped -> Delivered.

### 2. Admin & Supply Chain Management
- Inventory Control: Track raw material batches, quality test scores, moisture content, and EC levels.
- Order Fulfillment & Carrier Tracking Assignment.
- Analytics & Reports.

### 3. API Integrations & Auth
- JWT Authentication & Session Token Refresh.
- Socket.IO Real-time Communication.
- OpenAI-powered Logistics Assistant.
